nodes.description: Private address state variable holding the contract owner; written by the constructor and changeOwner, read by isOwner and getOwner.
Constructor that sets the deployer (msg.sender) as the initial owner and emits OwnerSet.
Public function guarded by the isOwner modifier that reassigns the owner state variable to newOwner.
External view function that returns the current owner state variable.
Modifier performing the access-control check require(msg.sender == owner) before executing the modified function body.
msg.sender used in the constructor as the deployer address that becomes the initial owner.
msg.sender used inside the isOwner modifier's require statement as the caller identity being checked.
Address parameter of changeOwner that becomes the new owner value.
Privileged state write 'owner = newOwner' performed in changeOwner; security depends entirely on the isOwner modifier's access-control check.

edges.reason: The untrusted msg.sender (deployer) is consumed as input by the constructor.
The constructor writes the owner state variable with msg.sender.
Caller-controlled msg.sender is compared against the stored owner in the isOwner require check; ownership authorization depends on this untrusted value.
The owner state variable is read inside the isOwner modifier as the reference value for the access-control comparison.
The isOwner modifier gates execution of changeOwner, enforcing that only the current owner can reassign ownership.
The newOwner parameter is used inside changeOwner as the value assigned to the owner state variable.
changeOwner triggers the privileged owner reassignment operation, whose safety relies on the modifier guard.
The unsafe owner-reassignment operation writes the owner state variable, changing contract authority.
getOwner reads the owner state variable to return the current owner address.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter newOwner has no independent security semantics; it only carries the value assigned to the owner state variable inside changeOwner and is fully covered by the isOwner access-control modifier.
